# glad

OpenGL 3.3 core function loader, generated by [glad 2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) with no extensions:

```sh
pip install glad2
glad --api gl:core=3.3 --extensions= --out-path third_party/glad c
```

Only core 3.3 functions are declared, so fixed-function calls such as `glBegin` do not compile. The generated code is WTFPL or CC0, with Apache-2.0 parts from the Khronos registry (see the header of `include/glad/gl.h`); `include/KHR/khrplatform.h` is under the Khronos MIT-style license in its header.
